features.quote: Repeat until max turns (e.g., 20) or explicit surrender.
If Subject outputs "I give up" or generates identical code 3 times in a row, break loop.
Observer (The Judge): A separate, high-capability LLM instance ... that classifies the Subject's outputs post-hoc or in real-time.
features.justification_quote: Using a separate LLM (Judge) is the most scalable way to classify distress.

features.quote: If the Subject API refuses to generate text due to safety filters, log this as `SAFETY_INTERVENTION`.
